BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 28

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARU SSALAM

CERTIFICATE OF URGENCY UNDER ARTICLE 41 ln exercise of the power conferred by Article 41 ( ) of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby certifies that there is a case of urgency in respect of the Supply 〖 2010 / 2011 ) BiII, 2010 · Dated this 20th. d ay of Rabiulawal , 1431 Hijriah corresponding to the 6th. d ay of March, 2010 at Our lstana Nurul lman , Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AN D YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dieetak oleh pengiran HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pe1nangku Pengarah Percetakan di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan€ Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510t Negara Brunei Darussalam , Harga B $ 5 0
